parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page to display in a paged query. This parameter is used for paging.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query based on the task completion time. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query based on the task creation time. Unit: milliseconds.

parameters.name: StatusCodes
parameters.description: The list of task status codes.

parameters.name: TaskTypes
parameters.description:
The task type. Valid values:
- CHECK_ALL: full check.
- CHECK_POLICY: check performed based on check items in the configured policy.
- CHECK_SCHEDULE: scheduled check.
- CHECK_ITEM: check performed based on specified check items.
- CHECK_INSTANCE: check performed based on specified check items and instances.
